# NASA SVS Milky Way 2020 reuse and credit

This candidate derives from NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio, Deep Star Maps 2020, item 4851. It is a catalog-derived visualization, not a new photograph or an enlargement of the project's former AI panorama.

**Credit to display with the game's third-party acknowledgements:**

NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.

The sky-only file contains no constellation figures, logos, people or labels. Constellation-overlay credits on the release page describe separate assets that are not used here.

## Verified reuse basis, 2026-09-13

- [NASA SVS reuse policy](https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/), updated 2024-03-27: SVS content is public domain unless otherwise noted, and may be downloaded, used and redistributed. No contrary image-specific restriction appears on the selected item.
- [NASA media guidelines](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/): acknowledge NASA as the source; do not imply agency endorsement or use protected identifiers as branding. Third-party exceptions must be respected.
- [Gaia DR2 credit instructions](https://gea.esac.esa.int/archive/documentation/GDR2/Miscellaneous/sec_credit_and_citation_instructions/): the Gaia data are open and free to use with ESA/Gaia/DPAC credit.
- [Source release](https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4851/), released 2020-09-09, page updated 2022-08-12.
- [Exact original EXR download](https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004800/a004851/milkyway_2020_8k.exr).

This is not an endorsement by NASA or ESA. Identify the derivative as a native-size display conversion and RGB8 quantization, with no artistic edits or resampling. SourceOrigin.json records the exact downloaded source/policy identities and native EXR header; manifest.json binds the retained PNG to the original bytes. The original 137,307,727-byte EXR remains outside tracked content, with its official URL and SHA256 preserved for reacquisition.
